secrets.name: CONTROL_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram control bot token from @BotFather. Required for real bot operation; the app runs in MOCK_TELEGRAM mode without it.

secrets.name: TELETHON_API_ID
secrets.description: Telethon API ID from https://my.telegram.org — only needed for template #11 (Config Auto-Scraper).

secrets.name: TELETHON_API_HASH
secrets.description: Telethon API hash from https://my.telegram.org — only needed for template #11 (Config Auto-Scraper).

secrets.name: INTERNAL_ALERT_SECRET
secrets.description: Shared secret for the /internal/security-alert endpoint (Falco integration). Optional.
